拾起舊符，聽見山路的呼喚。: Pick up the old talisman and hear the mountain path calling.
阿澤在廟口拾起舊符，紙上浮出一條山路。山裡隨即有人叫他，虎爺卻踩住紅繩，不肯讓路: A-Ze picks up an old talisman outside the temple. A mountain path appears on the paper. Someone in the hills calls his name, but Tiger Lord pins down the red cord with a paw and refuses to let him pass.
我沒說過名字。你也覺得奇怪？: I never told anyone my name. You think it's strange too?
細聲催他跟緊，說這樣才不會走丟。: The soft voice urges him to stay close, saying he will not get lost that way.
我想去看看。你陪我，覺得不對就攔住我。: I want to take a look. Come with me, and stop me if something feels wrong.
虎爺挪開腳，契印在神籙上亮起。廟前的香煙逆著風，飄向山裡。: Tiger Lord lifts his paw, and a pact mark lights up on the Shenlu. Incense smoke outside the temple drifts against the wind, toward the hills.
先記住這裡。回來時，我們還走這級石階。: Let's remember this spot. When we come back, we'll take these same stone steps.
山路上的遠影: A Distant Figure on the Path
解開第一道威脅，學會觀察攻守與清場手段。: Deal with the first threat. Learn to read attack and defense, and how to clear the field.
黃昏的轉角站著紅衣身影。她腳下沒有腳印，說的卻是廟口那句話。: At dusk, a figure in red stands around the bend. She leaves no footprints, but repeats the words A-Ze heard outside the temple.
跟緊，就不會走丟。: Stay close, and you won't get lost.
剛才是妳叫我？先別走。: Were you the one calling me? Wait. Don't go yet.
虎爺橫身擋住去路，阿澤停下腳步，望向她身後。: Tiger Lord blocks the path with his body. A-Ze stops and looks behind her.
威脅散去，紅影也不見了。地上的繩結，與廟口那個結法相同。: The threat fades, and the red figure is gone. A cord on the ground is tied with the same knot as the one outside the temple.
每次快看清楚，妳就往後退。是要我一直追？: Every time I almost get a good look, you back away. Do you want me to keep chasing you?
留意敵方進攻，選擇回應的時機。: Watch the enemy's attacks and choose when to respond.
缺角石階和歪樹又出現在眼前，天色卻比上次更暗。紅影的呼喚這回從背後傳來。: The chipped stone steps and crooked tree appear again, but the sky is darker this time. Now the red figure's call comes from behind him.
虎爺，留在我旁邊。我們不追，等她過來。: Tiger Lord, stay beside me. We're not chasing her. Let her come to us.
攻勢過後，樹上的紅繩一震，一段山路也跟著消失。: After the attack, a red cord on the tree trembles. A stretch of the mountain path vanishes with it.
路是被這些繩子接住的。難怪走哪邊，都回到這裡。: These cords are holding the paths together. No wonder every turn brings us back here.
判斷先後威脅，保留真正需要的回應。: Decide which threat comes first, and save your response for when you need it.
霧裡先傳來求救聲，接著響起虎爺的低吼。真正的虎爺明明就在阿澤身邊。: A cry for help rises from the fog, followed by Tiger Lord's growl. Yet the real Tiger Lord is right beside A-Ze.
學得再像也沒用。你在這裡，我看得見。: It doesn't matter how well it copies you. You're right here. I can see you.
魔神仔從樹根旁抬頭，另一側的呼救又急了起來。: Mosina peeks up beside a tree root. The cries on the other side grow more urgent.
我們不分開。先看清它要把誰引走。: We stick together. First, let's see who it's trying to lure away.
霧中的威脅退去，一扇老屋門露了出來。紅影站在門邊，將門推開。: The threat in the fog retreats, revealing the door of an old house. The red figure stands beside it and pushes it open.
一路都在叫我跟緊，現在又要我進門。裡面藏了什麼？: All this way you've told me to stay close. Now you want me to go inside. What's in there?
封阻餘策: One More Way to Break the Bind
回收遺落符片；跳過本章也能繼續主線。: Recover the missing talisman pieces. You can skip this chapter and continue the main story.
虎爺在岔路刨出半張符，另半張被魔神仔帶進霧裡。符上的畫痕，很像紅繩的結法。: At a fork in the path, Tiger Lord digs up half a talisman. Mosina has taken the other half into the fog. Its markings look much like the knots in the red cord.
我想把它拼起來看看。也許能弄懂，這種結為什麼越拉越緊。: I want to put it back together. Maybe it'll show us why these knots tighten the more we pull.
符片拼合，背面的反扣也露了出來。阿澤用指尖沿著畫痕比了比。: The pieces fit together, revealing a reverse loop on the back. A-Ze traces the markings with his fingertip.
原來扣在背面。硬往外拉，反而鬆不開。: So it hooks around the back. Pulling harder won't loosen it.
不要替她開門: Do Not Open the Door for Her
清除屋內威脅，依自己的判斷選擇解法。: Clear the threats inside the house. Choose your own way to handle them.
門後竟是台南老屋。船鈴與城磚上的記憶被神籙展開，阿澤踏進了投影，並未回到過去。: Beyond the door is an old house in Tainan. The Shenlu unfolds memories held in a ship's bell and old fort bricks. A-Ze has stepped into a projection, not traveled into the past.
牆上寫著「不要替她開門」。這個「她」，是誰？: The wall says, “Do not open the door for her.” Who is “her”?
進了門，總得留點東西。: Once you come in, you have to leave something behind.
先讓我看見求救的人。我不會只聽聲音就照辦。: Show me who's asking for help first. I won't do as I'm told just because I hear a voice.
屋魅退去，船鈴裡仍傳來求救聲。紅影留在門外，催阿澤把裡面的人帶出來。: The House Specter retreats, but cries for help still come from the ship's bell. The red figure stays outside, urging A-Ze to bring out whoever is inside.
人，我會找。妳先別碰那扇門。: I'll find them. You stay away from that door for now.
把牽引變成護送: Turn the Pull into a Lifeline
護送兩批投影上岸；保護留場與主動清場都能建立救援機會。: Escort two groups of projections ashore. Keeping allies on the field or clearing enemies can both create rescue chances.
船鈴把院落化成風浪中的甲板。紅繩拖著求救的投影入海，亡魂首領又攔住回岸的方向。: The ship's bell turns the courtyard into a deck tossed by wind and waves. Red cords drag the pleading projections into the sea, while the leader of the dead blocks their way ashore.
先站穩。他們得有地方上來。: Find your footing first. They need somewhere to climb aboard.
岸邊還有一批。虎爺，守住這段繩，我來接人。: There's another group by the shore. Tiger Lord, hold this part of the cord. I'll bring them in.
兩批投影都上了岸，船鈴才安靜。阿澤沿繩看去，另一端扣在城磚上。: Only when both groups reach shore does the bell fall silent. A-Ze follows the cord with his eyes. Its other end is fastened to a fort brick.
妳連下一處都知道。為什麼自己不進去？: You even know where we'll go next. Why won't you go in yourself?
留一條同伴能走的路: Leave a Path for Your Friends
建立兩段突破通路；回手、清除與保留資源皆由你選擇。: Open two stretches of the route. Choose whether to return cards to hand, clear enemies, or save resources.
城磚展開安平城門的記憶。守衛之影補上缺口，門後卻還有投影沒能通過。: The bricks unfold a memory of Anping's gate. Guard shadows fill the gaps, while projections remain trapped behind the gate.
後面的人還沒走完。下一次開路的力量，得留著。: Not everyone behind us is through yet. Save enough strength to open the way again.
先送這一批。我們守在這裡，再把下一段接起來。: Let's get this group through first. We'll hold here, then connect the next stretch.
兩段通路接通，最後的投影越過城門。兩件錨物一起發亮，只剩阿澤手中的繩結尚未鬆開。: The two stretches connect, and the last projection passes through the gate. Both anchor objects glow. Only the knot in A-Ze's hand remains tight.
原來妳要借我的手，解開這個。別躲了，出來把話說清楚。: So you needed my hands to untie this. Stop hiding. Come out and explain.
帶著自己的牌組面對紅衣靈主，以任何合法打法取得勝利。: Face the Crimson Spirit Lord with your own deck. Win with any legal strategy.
山路重新出現，霧也散了。引路孩童的幻相褪去，紅衣靈主握著繩結，站到阿澤面前。: The mountain path returns as the fog clears. The illusion of the guiding child fades. Holding the knot, the Crimson Spirit Lord stands before A-Ze.
看清我，就能找到出口？: You think seeing me clearly will lead you to the way out?
至少我知道，不能再照妳說的走。虎爺，這回我們自己找路。: At least I know I can't keep following your directions. Tiger Lord, this time we find our own way.
紅繩鬆落，山路終於連回廟埕。阿澤將最後一道繩結收進神籙。: The red cord falls loose, and the path finally reconnects with the temple courtyard. A-Ze places the final knot inside the Shenlu.
到了。出發時那級石階，我還記得。: We're back. I still remember those steps from when we set out.
虎爺忽然轉向遠山；神籙另一頁，有一道陌生符令正在發光。: Tiger Lord suddenly turns toward the distant hills. On another page of the Shenlu, an unfamiliar talisman sigil begins to glow.
回到廟埕，紅繩再次發亮。這次沒有山裡的催促聲，只有一隻雲豹帶著女孩走近。: Back in the temple courtyard, the red cord lights up again. This time, there is no urgent voice from the hills. A clouded leopard approaches with a girl.
牠們倒先認識了。我叫阿澤，剛才這道光也是妳的？: Looks like they've already made friends. I'm A-Ze. Was that light yours too?
我是予安。符令把我帶過來，沒想到會遇見你們。: I'm Yu-an. My talisman brought me here. I didn't expect to meet you two.
來切磋一場？我想看看，你和雲豹怎麼互相照應。: Want a friendly match? I'd like to see how you and your leopard watch out for each other.
剛才你一往前，牠就補到側邊。在山裡，我總要回頭找虎爺好幾次。: When you moved forward, it covered your side right away. Back in the hills, I kept turning around to find Tiger Lord.
牠也一直看著你。下次需要接應，叫上我們。: It was watching you the whole time too. Next time you need backup, call us.
虎爺挨著雲豹坐下，紅繩與符令的光慢慢相合。: Tiger Lord sits down beside the clouded leopard. The light of the red cord slowly joins with the talisman's glow.
說好了。有人迷路，就一起去找。: It's a promise. If someone gets lost, we'll find them together.
